challengeTypes: identify: What is the LARGEST sense organ of the human body? (The skin vs The eye vs The ear)
identify: What are the TWO main layers of the skin? (Epidermis (outer) and dermis (inner) vs Skull and brain vs Heart and lungs)

sort: Drag each skin function to the correct layer (Epidermis: protects from germs and dirt, prevents water loss, outer cover | Dermis: has nerve endings for touch, has sweat glands, has hair follicles, feels hot/cold/pain)

identify: When you touch a HOT cup of tea, what happens FIRST? (Nerve endings in the skin feel the heat and send a message vs The brain pulls the hand away vs The hand moves on its own without any signal)

sort: Drag the signal pathway in the correct order (1. Skin feels the hot cup | 2. Nerve endings send a signal | 3. Signal travels along nerve to spinal cord | 4. Spinal cord sends signal to brain | 5. Brain decides to pull hand away | 6. Brain sends message back through nerves to hand muscles)
identify: Which organ is the CONTROL CENTRE of the body that helps us think, learn, and remember? (The brain vs The heart vs The stomach)

sort: Drag each nervous system part to its correct function (Brain: thinking, learning, memory, control centre | Spinal cord: carries messages between brain and body | Nerves: carry signals to and from all body parts | Sense organs: collect information from surroundings)
sort: Drag each sense organ to what it senses (Eyes: sight | Ears: hearing | Nose: smell | Tongue: taste | Skin: touch, hot, cold, pain)
extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Skin as a sense organ — skin is the largest sense organ. Two layers: epidermis (outer, thin, protects from germs/dirt/water loss) and dermis (inner, thick, has nerve endings for touch/pressure/hot/cold/pain, has sweat glands, has hair follicles). Skin protects body, senses touch/heat/cold/pain, controls body temperature through sweating. (2) Nervous system — three main parts: brain (soft, jelly-like, protected inside skull, control centre for thinking/learning/memory/feelings/movement), spinal cord (long thick bundle of nerves inside backbone, carries messages between brain and body), nerves (thin wire-like branches throughout body, carry electrical signals). Signal pathway: sense organ collects info -> nerve carries signal -> spinal cord -> brain decides -> brain sends message back -> muscles respond. Five sense organs: eyes (sight), ears (hearing), nose (smell), tongue (taste), skin (touch). Misconceptions: 'the hand pulls away on its own without the brain' (the signal goes to the brain which decides and sends back a response — though reflexes can bypass the brain for speed), 'skin is just a cover' (skin is a SENSE ORGAN with nerve endings that feel touch, hot, cold, and pain), 'the brain is not protected' (the brain is protected by the skull, the spinal cord by the backbone), 'nerves carry blood' (nerves carry electrical SIGNALS/messages, not blood — blood vessels carry blood), 'epidermis and dermis are the same' (epidermis is the outer thin protective layer, dermis is the inner thick layer with nerve endings and glands). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function SkinNervousGame), NOT export default. Export interface SkinNervousGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
